viewing_check: Read the cap hallmarks with a loupe: sterling lion passant and town/date letter versus plated EPNS marks; weigh the cap if possible. Check dent severity, whether the cap hinge and glass body are intact, and whether the leather is real crocodile. Confirm the stick handle is ivory or bone (and import/export restrictions).
